If playing Wk 7, chances of in-game aggravation = high #Colts Tyler Warren - Thurs practice report = key. Most would miss Wk 7 (Avg = 3 wks for groin re-aggravation) 2/9 [3/9] #Eagles Saquon Barkley - Reports suggest likely playing Wk 7. If logs LP x3, typically would see mild dip in usage (10-15%) but no dip in efficiency. Re-injury = 15-20% (high) #Bills DJ Moore - Data strongly suggests return Wk 8 at pre-injury production level (Wk 7 = bye) 3/9 [4/9] #Jets Breece Hall - Lean Wk 7-8. Most RBs would have practiced Wed if playing Wk 7. If LP x2, data suggests ~50% to play + fewer touches #Buccaneers Baker Mayfield - Likely playing. Suspect strong play initially. Re-aggravation risk = high and would likely affect play 4/9 [5/9] #Cardinals Jeremiyah Love - Lean Wk 8-9 return, w/Wk 9 more likely. Likely to see gradual ramp up in usage + efficiency. Re-injury risk = mild-moderate #Chiefs Rashee Rice - DNP Wed. Wk 7 still in play, but lean toward Wk 8 return. Re-injury = 20% (high) 5/9 [6/9] #Seahawks Zach Charbonnet - 8 months post-ACL = early return. Injury risk = elevated. Most would see ~15-20% efficiency dip + take 4 wks to ramp up workload #Chargers Ladd McConkey - Likely return Wk 8 (Wk 7 = bye) at ~full strength for first time since Wk 1 (ribs + foot) 6/9 [7/9] #Patriots AJ Brown - Opportunity = likely to be high, but suspect ankle played role in drops/missed targets Wk 6. Most WRs would take ~4 wks to ramp up efficiency. Would still start in most formats #Texans Tank Dell - Data suggests limited snap share for next several wks 7/9 [8/9] #Vikings Justin Jefferson - LP Wed w/ankle. Data heavily favors playing + strong production #Raiders Brock Bowers - LP Wed w/new hamstring + calf. Has done LP most wks w/FP after. Thurs + Fri will clarify if this is just rest vs actual injury. Must start when active 8/9 [9/9] #Packers Matthew Golden - LP Wed w/shoulder. Data heavily favors playing w/o dip #Bears Kyle Monangai - Out Wk 7. Lean return Wk 8 #Buccaneers Emeka Egbuka - Concussion + foot. Concern = possible aggravation of pre-season toe. Many in '26 have cleared concussion in <1 wk 9/9

articles.title: BIGGEST NFL DFS/Fantasy Week 7 SMASHES/FADES (Main):
articles.author: Sean Mitchell
articles.summary: BIGGEST NFL DFS/Fantasy Week 7 SMASHES/FADES (Main): - SMASH STACK BUCCANEERS @ PANTHERS: Easy one here even with a game total at just 44.5. The Eagle's (Tanner McKee) threw 45 times last week vs this Carolina defense. Aaron Rodgers threw 49 times vs this Buccaneer's defense in Week 6. Baker Mayfield is likely returning here this week and hopefully will boost this offense. We know Carolina is going to put up points, and typically any team that plays them does as well. Hammering the passing game for both squads. - FADE MIAMI DOLPHINS: Just a tough spot here in MetLife Stadium against a decent Jet's defense. Ollie Gordon has been a revelation for this Phin's offense, but overall they are still just not that great. Passing game will inevitably rely on the run game and I don't see it being a big threat here. Willis rushing is interesting. Other than that, I am basically just crossing off Dolphins this week. Game total at just 39.5, I am good in what books think will be a low-scoring affair. - SMASH STACK 49ERS @ FALCONS: We get the 2nd-highest total on the Week 7 board here of 49.5 in a dome with two high-powered offenses. Both defenses have shown nice pressure, but have allowed points, especially the Falcons. Obviously, the Niners are having some woes at WR with injuries. Evans continues to sit all week in practices but tends to suit up still. This go-around he is dealing with a sore achillies, so that is not great among his shoulder and rib injuries. Kittle and CMC easy looks here, Cooks has stepped up with Deebo out. One of Watkins/Cowing will likely get some extra snaps. Leaning Watkins. Penix/Bijan/London main Falcons of course. Can mix in a BRob Jr revenge game? Pitts possibly. Jahan Dotson has come a bit alive over last 3 weeks scoring a TD in 2 of 3 of those weeks. - FADE BROWNS @ TITANS: Do I really need to talk extensively into why this game is a fade? Just cross it off the board. Total sitting at a meager 37.5 points. Both offenses are worth the price of dinner at Arby's. No great appealing options on either side of this game. Just leave it alone and focus on much better environments. - SMASH STACK BENGALS @ RAVENS: This matchup is ALWAYS set up perfectly for fantasy greatness. Ja'Marr Chase LOVES playing against Marlon Humphries (any torching him). Interesting to see if Lamar Jackson will be a go for this game. There is a small bit of optimism but will need to monitor practices to end the week. Either way, CIN D is still CIN D even though their front-seven has gotten a bit better. They are still allowing points. Whether it is Lamar or Snoop Huntley, I still expect Ravens to have success here in a game with a total at 48.5. - SMASH STACK PACKERS @ LIONS: EASILY the chalk matchup of the week and for damn good reason. This Lion's defense is just terrible. T-3 worst ranks in most defensive categories, mostly in the secondary. Jordan Love has been torching opposing defenses over the last couple of weeks with Christian Watson and Matthew Golden. Packers look to be getting Josh Jacobs back this week. Packer's defense is mediocre as well, so Goff here at home will put up points. Highest game total of the week at 53.5. No need to get cute and fade this game in any form, but mixing it in with some other spots is likely the key.
